units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 7:6">Targ. Gen. VII, 6</cite> (O. ed. Berl. <cite ref="U01103"><he>שֵׁית</he></cite>; ed. Vien. <cite ref="U02071"><he>שִׁתְּ</he></cite>). Ib. XXX, 20 (O. ed. Berl. <cite ref="U01103"><he>שיתה</he></cite>); a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Pesachim 94a:4">Pes. 94ᵃ</cite> <he>ש׳ אלפי וכ׳</he> the world (distance from sunrise to sunset) is six thousand parasangs.
Snh. 97ᵃ ש׳ אלפי שני הוי וכ׳ the world will exist six thousand years; a. fr.—Pl. שִׁיתִּין, שִׁתִּ׳ sixty.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 25:26">Targ. Gen. XXV, 26</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 92b:2">B. Kam. 92ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ תכלי</he>, v. <cite ref="K00656"><he>כַּכָּא</he></cite>.
Ab. Zar. 69ᵃ בש׳ requires sixty portions to be neutralized; a. e.—שִׁיתַּת עֲשַׂר, שֵׁיתֵיסַר, שֵׁיתְסַר, שֵׁיתְסְרֵי, שִׁיתְ׳ sixteen; sixteenth.
Targ. Y. Deut. XXXIV, 8 (ed. Vien. שֵׁתֵיסַר); a. fr.—שֵׁיתְסְרָאָה m. the sixteenth.
<cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 24:14">Targ. I Chr. XXIV, 14</cite> (ed. Lag. <cite ref="U00986"><he>שִׁיסְרָאָה</he></cite>).
